description: This file defines functions and types for building, manipulating, and generating JSON schema configurations for the OpenClaw project, including schema documentation, filtering, and versioning.

methods.name: buildFieldDocumentation
methods.description: Constructs documentation objects for schema fields based on labels and help texts.

methods.name: applyFieldDocumentation
methods.description: Recursively applies titles and descriptions to JSON schema objects based on dot-path matching.

methods.name: applyNodeDocumentation
methods.description: Assigns title and description to a schema node if not already set, based on documentation mappings.

methods.name: stripChannelSchema
methods.description: Removes or hides the 'channels' property and $schema from the schema.

methods.name: stripObjectPropertyPath
methods.description: Deletes a property at a specified path within a schema.

methods.name: stripLegacyCompatSchemaPaths
methods.description: Removes legacy hidden paths from schema for compatibility.

methods.name: stripLegacyCompatHints
methods.description: Removes legacy hidden paths from UI hints for compatibility.

methods.name: computeBaseConfigSchemaStablePayload
methods.description: Generates and caches the stable payload containing the JSON schema, UI hints, and version.

methods.name: computeBaseConfigSchemaResponse
methods.description: Returns the current base configuration schema response, including timestamp.
